A 53-year-old woman was killed after being allegedly hit by an unidentified vehicle while out on her morning walk at Nadakkila near Pazhayangadi in Kannur on Thursday (October 22, 2026).
The deceased was identified as K. Sulochana. The accident occurred around 6 a.m. She sustained serious injuries and was rushed to the hospital, but could not be saved. The body was shifted to the mortuary at Kannur Government Medical College Hospital.
The police have registered a case of unnatural death and are examining CCTV footage to trace the vehicle. Sulochana is survived by her husband and daughter.
